YouTube uses playlists to identify special collections of videos for a channel, such as: - uploaded videos - favorite videos - positively rated (liked) videos - watch history - watch later To be more specific, these lists are associated with a channel, which is a collection of a person, group, or company's videos, playlists, and other YouTube information. You can retrieve the playlist IDs for each of these lists from the channel resource for a given channel. You can then use the playlistItems.list method to retrieve any of those lists. You can also add or remove items from those lists by calling the playlistItems.insert and playlistItems.delete methods. For example, if a user gives a positive rating to a video, you would insert that video into the liked videos playlist for that user's channel.

These are topics that are centrally featured in the video, and it can be said that the video is mainly about each of these. You can retrieve information about each topic using the < a href="http://wiki.freebase.com/wiki/Topic_API">Freebase Topic API.

topicCategories.description: A list of Wikipedia URLs that provide a high-level description of the video's content.

relevantTopicIds.description: Similar to topic_id, except that these topics are merely relevant to the video. These are topics that may be mentioned in, or appear in the video. You can retrieve information about each topic using Freebase Topic API.

VideoTopicDetails.description: Freebase topic information related to the video.

altText.description: Internationalized alt text that describes the sticker image and any animation associated with it.

altTextLanguage.description: Specifies the localization language in which the alt text is returned.

stickerId.description: Unique identifier of the Super Sticker. This is a shorter form of the alt_text that includes pack name and a recognizable characteristic of the sticker.

countries.description: The country the channel section is targeting.

languages.description: The language the channel section is targeting.

regions.description: The region the channel section is targeting.

name.description: The human-readable name of the language in the language itself.

hl.description: A short BCP-47 code that uniquely identifies a language.

I18nLanguageSnippet.description: Basic details about an i18n language, such as language code and human-readable name.

description: The YouTube Data API v3 is an API that provides access to YouTube data, such as videos, playlists, and channels.
